lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible; spacing is approximately uniform across the rib cage (~45-50 pixels) and becomes more compressed near the posterior flank (~30 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is located at the dorsal origin of the fourth vertical line from the shoulder, where the line splits before descending the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is truncated mid-shoulder; the tenth and eleventh posterior lines terminate before reaching the mid-lateral point of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: 6 high-contrast white spots are clustered on the lateral aspect of the haunch, arranged in two vertically stacked rows of three.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, creating a short semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate curvature, projecting posterodorsally at a ~55-degree angle from the frontal bone before curving medially at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 2.2 times the width of the horn bases in the 2D silhouette.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes, dual white spots on the lower cheek/jaw, and a dense ventral fringe of dark hair extending from the lower neck to the abdomen.
